name: io.github.chrischall/therapyportal-mcp
description: TherapyNotes client portal: appointments, documents, billing, messages; confirm-gated sends, uploads

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_PRACTICE
environmentVariables.description: Your practice's portal code: the part after /p/ in its TherapyPortal URL (www.therapyportal.com/p/<code>/).

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email you sign in to TherapyPortal with. Set with the password to sign in server-side; leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your TherapyPortal password. A rejected sign-in is never retried automatically.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_DOB
environmentVariables.description: Only if the portal asks for a date of birth at sign-in: that date, as MM/DD/YYYY. Tried once; never retried, because the portal limits attempts.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: server or fetchproxy. Default: server when email and password are both set, otherwise fetchproxy.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy concentrator port (fetchproxy transport only, default 37149). The whole fleet shares this one port; override only when hosting.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where downloaded files are written on the server transport (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads and ~/Documents. A per-call dest must resolve inside one of these.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_INLINE_DOWNLOADS
environmentVariables.description: true returns downloaded bytes inline (base64) instead of writing to disk, for a hosted runner whose disk you cannot reach. Default false.

environmentVariables.name: THERAPYPORTAL_UPLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folders an upload's file_path must be inside (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads, ~/Documents and ~/Desktop; $MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads when hosted.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Confirm-gate mode for every write (secure messages, document uploads). ask-user (default) returns a preview + confirmToken and needs a second call with that token; auto lets a capable host confirm in one step; an unrecognised value fails closed (refuse).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: on (default) lets the host confirm a write interactively; off forces the confirmToken round-trip.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
